title: MCP Server Configuration
description: Configuration for external MCP servers used by azdw ai-chat

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g., '1.0'). Used for migration between schema versions.

McpServerDefinition.description: Configuration for a single MCP server

url.description: URL of a remote MCP server (e.g. 'https://mcp.example.com/mcp'). When set, HTTP transport is used. Mutually exclusive with 'command'/'args'.

command.description: Executable command to start the MCP server (e.g., 'npx', 'python', 'node'). Used only for stdio transport (when 'url' is not set).

args.description: Command-line arguments for the server. Used only for stdio transport.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the server process. Used only for stdio transport.

auth.description: Optional Entra ID authentication configuration for remote MCP servers.

approve.description: List of tool names that are automatically approved without user confirmation

McpServerAuthConfig.description: Authentication configuration for a remote MCP server. Omit the 'auth' block to use MCP OAuth 2.1 auto-discovery (McpOAuth) — the same protocol used by VS Code Copilot Chat.

authType.description: Auth flow. 'McpOAuth' (default): MCP Authorization Protocol, OAuth 2.1 auto-discovery via RFC 9728 — works with any MCP-compliant server, no pre-configuration needed. 'None': no auth. 'EntraIdDeviceCode': Microsoft Entra ID device code (CLI/headless). 'EntraIdInteractive': Entra ID browser pop-up (desktop). 'EntraIdClientCredentials': Entra ID service-to-service.

clientId.description: For McpOAuth: optional pre-registered client ID (skips dynamic client registration). For EntraId flows: required — the application (client) ID of the Entra ID app registration.

tenantId.description: Required for EntraId flows. Directory (tenant) ID of the Entra ID tenant where the server app is registered.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request. For McpOAuth: optional — server-advertised scopes are used when omitted. For EntraId: e.g. 'api://<server-client-id>/MCP.Tools.Execute'.

clientSecret.description: Client secret for EntraIdClientCredentials flow. Prefer injecting via an environment variable.
